cppLayoutChange: One private availability bool; requires recompiling affected C++ consumers.
portPolicy: Only wx.request URL in library_wxslim_fetch.js normalizes HTTP:80/HTTPS:443, including explicit defaults. Preserve userinfo/IPv6/other ports/path/query/fragment. Ordinary browser fetch unchanged.
responsePolicy: One successfully parsed valid HTTP response makes headers available even if empty; get_response_headers consumes once. New request and close clear availability. Pending, JS error, invalid status and header parse failure cannot set availability. All four connection-error transitions invalidate availability; consumed headers do not become available again. Unknown JS fetch states cannot create availability.
limitations: Offline actual JS functions with modeled wx/heap are not platform or WASM evidence.
C++ source/replay assertions are not C++ execution.
C++ response fix affects ordinary browser web client too; regression must be tested before use.
No recipe, engine checkout, scenes, previous source patch/metadata or successful package changed.
No streaming, retry, WebSocket, production endpoint or credentials.

validation.scope: Actual candidate/browser JS functions with modeled wx/heap; exact source replay and C++ textual contract only.
